summary: POSCO HOLDINGS INC. filed a Form 6-K containing a provisional earnings release for its subsidiary POSCO for Q1 2026. The report presents revenue, operating profit, profit before income tax, and net profit figures in KRW trillions, comparing Q1 2026 to Q4 2025 and Q1 2025. The financials are prepared under K-IFRS and are subject to independent auditor review. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure with no indication of a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign.
